## Summary
Completion-verifier must emit a structured typed-enum verdict (P1 in {PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, INCONCLUSIVE}) in all exit paths. LLM orchestrators read the enum and halt on non-PASS without free-form narrative.

## Done Definitions
- Typed-enum schema defined (P1 in {PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, INCONCLUSIVE}) and emitted by completion-verifier in all exit paths
- Fixed-template narrative renderer emits structured verdict text (no free-form LLM summary)
- LLM orchestrator reads enum field, halts on non-PASS
- SC11 coverage: self-application evidence recorded (second-source verification)
- Consumer audit: all callers of completion-verifier updated to read enum field
- Manifest completeness: machine-readable list of all epic stories cross-checked against self-application evidence; any story missing from audit trail is a hard error

## SC Coverage
SC1, SC11

## Walking Skeleton
P0 — Foundation for S2, S3, S1b, S11

## Escalation Policy
Escalate when blocked
